slice.proposal_under_test: A Chat-exposed lightweight GitHub Contents API create/readback can serve as a role-local persistence primitive without a Work-mode, protected-primary, or manual-user execution step in the observed effect chain.
slice.tested_scope: Exactly one create_file call for a UTF-8 JSON payload in research_audits/primary_verification/ followed by one fetch_file readback of that exact path. This slice did not test retries, rate-limit interruption/resume, concurrent CAS conflict, scheduler persistence, GitHub Actions/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package services, external compute, monthly/trial/paid quota exhaustion, or account billing.

interpretation: The observed Chat-to-GitHub repository write/readback primitive is directly reachable and durable at the exact tested path without an observed Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution hop. That narrow fact does not establish Phase-1 acceptance because quota-zero, cost, rate-limit-resume, conflict/duplicate, and broader dependency-elimination gates remain unverified.
continuation: On the next primary_source_verifier invocation, re-bootstrap current manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE/DESIRED_STATE/DOWNSTREAM_STATE and reconstruct this payload+receipt as predecessor evidence.
